Paragraph: The reaction of compound $\mathbf{P}$ with $\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{MgBr}$ (excess) in $\left(\mathrm{C}_{2} \mathrm{H}_{5}\right)_{2} \mathrm{O}$ followed by addition of $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}$ gives $\mathbf{Q}$. [Et in compound $\mathbf{P}$ is ethyl group]
